result.summary: Verdict FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (branch feature/binary-config-serve-20260930). Scope: Freestyle VM creation, endpoint/bootstrap failure cleanup, provider retries/timeouts, orphan prevention. 3 findings: HIGH prepare() outer bound (150s = GIT_PUSH_TIMEOUT+API_TIMEOUT) is SHORTER than its own inner timeoutMs budgets (210s worst case: init 30s + clone 120s + checkout 30s + systemctl 30s), so bounded()'s Promise.race rejects while the abandoned prepare() keeps running, discarding the endpoint and livelocking the worker in booting; MEDIUM those abandoned retries run concurrently against one VM and race each other on the worker-derived clone staging dir and the fixed /opt/swarmforge Git credential paths; LOW createWorker's non-atomic slug pre-check can create duplicate VMs under a create-timeout (recovery catches them later). F1/F2 reproduced with Bun 1.4.2 + local fakes at exact shipped default ratios; F3 code-evidenced, real API unverified. Tests: lifecycle 34/34 and adapters 7/7 pass, exit 0. No source changes.
result.details:
F1 (HIGH, src/coordinator.ts:462, root cause coordinator.ts:41-59 + providers/freestyle.ts:110-185): outer bound SWARMFORGE_GIT_PUSH_TIMEOUT_MS+SWARMFORGE_API_TIMEOUT_MS = 150000ms at defaults (config.ts:53,89) but prepare()'s own inner timeoutMs budgets sum to 210000ms (freestyle.ts:117=30000, :131=GIT_PUSH_TIMEOUT_MS=120000, :144=30000, :180=30000). Promise.race rejects at 150s; store.patch(id,{endpoint}) at coordinator.ts:467 never runs. Trigger: any healthy guest needing >150s to bootstrap. Consequence: worker never reaches ready, never creates a session, never dispatches; burns a billable VM (idleTimeoutSeconds/ttlSeconds -1, freestyle.ts:51-53) until the 300s provision timeout, and fail() retains rather than destroys it. Reproduced: threshold.ts at shipped ratios scaled 1:1000 gives inner=149ms -> 1 attempt, endpoint RECORDED; inner=160/210/260ms -> 16 attempts, endpoint LOST, state booting. converge.ts (staged to the four inner budgets): attempts 16, completed server-side 15, endpoint null. converge-fast.ts reaches waiting in 1 attempt, isolating the bound. Guards do not help: provision timeout (config.ts:86) converts livelock to failure; the catch at coordinator.ts:510-526 deliberately retries, re-triggering it; exclusive() (coordinator.ts:251-257) bounds concurrency but not retries. No test slows prepare(): helpers.ts:48-51 is instant, adapters.test.ts:138-170 calls prepare() with no coordinator and no bound. Fix: bound must exceed inner sum, and/or AbortSignal into bounded(); single-flight prepare() per worker.

F2 (MEDIUM, providers/freestyle.ts:126, :129, :193, :229-240): staging is worker_id-derived only, clone command starts `rm -rf staging && git clone && mv`, credential paths are fixed /opt/swarmforge/git-auth and git-secret written then unconditionally rm -f'd. F1's abandoned promise escapes exclusive(), so retries overlap: B's rm -rf deletes A's live clone; A's cleanup deletes B's credential. Reproduced: race.ts (inner 660ms vs bound 430ms) -> p1,p2 with maxConcurrent 2 and 2 clone failures ('credential file deleted by a concurrent prepare'); stack.ts -> 150 attempts, 1 hit on a live clone. Consequences: spurious clone/credential failures misattributed to the network, and a wider credential window. Fix: single-flight, and/or attempt-scoped paths.

F3 (LOW, providers/freestyle.ts:46-48, bound coordinator.ts:457): check-then-create on slug is non-atomic; SDK backgrounds long requests (freestyle/dist/client.js BACKGROUND_AFTER_SECS=5) so a create can outlive the bound, and a retry passes the pre-check before the first VM is visible -> duplicate VMs for one worker. NOT reproduced against the real API (out of scope); coordinator mechanism reproduced with a visibility-lag fake: 2 VMs, max concurrent create 3. recover() (coordinator.ts:365-396) surfaces the extra as a recovery_required orphan, so impact is a duplicate billable VM plus a spurious recovery record. Fix: idempotency key, or single-flight createWorker; treat same-slug VM as adoption.

Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md (15.0 KiB) and findings.json (7.4 KiB). Probes live only under /tmp/rev-wc71d/probe. /workspace/repo unchanged at 5672ead2a526e07fea9ed11e58b3725e42013527 and clean.

result.followup_reason: Three actionable defects in provisioning/bootstrap. F1 (HIGH): the outer bound on prepare() is shorter than the sum of its own inner timeoutMs budgets, livelocking a healthy-but-slow guest in booting and discarding its endpoint. F2 (MEDIUM): those abandoned retries overlap on the worker-derived clone staging directory and the fixed /opt/swarmforge Git credential paths. F3 (LOW): createWorker's non-atomic slug pre-check can create duplicate VMs under a create-timeout. F1 and F2 share one fix: make provider.prepare/createWorker single-flight per worker with an AbortSignal-aware bound, plus attempt-scoped guest paths.
